description: Two ADSR envelopes, each with its own four stage knobs and its own gate, and each able to loop.

params.text: Attack time of the second envelope.
Attack time of the first envelope.
Decay time of the first envelope.
Decay time of the second envelope.
Sustain level of the first envelope.
Sustain level of the second envelope.
Release time of the first envelope.
Release time of the second envelope.
Sets what happens after a stage finishes: up, each envelope runs once per gate; middle, the attack and decay repeat; down, the envelope restarts once it has settled on the sustain level.

inputs.text: The gate for the first envelope: it attacks on the rise and releases on the fall.
The gate for the second envelope: it attacks on the rise and releases on the fall.

outputs.text: The second envelope as a voltage.
The first envelope as a voltage.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
With no gate patched an envelope stays at rest unless the switch is set to loop, in which case it runs on its own.

inputs.0:
high above 1.67V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
